parsed.quote: Let me know if anything's unclear.

facts.claim: Arjun sent Ravi at partnerco.test the integration doc Ravi had asked for, and asked him to say if anything is unclear.
No reply time of Ravi's is measured: the file holds no answer from him since the doc went.
The file's history holds no earlier card or outcome: the engine sees it for the first time.

inferences.claim: The move is Ravi's: Arjun answered his ask, and the note asks nothing of Ravi beyond questions if he has any.
Nothing in the file is owed by the founder.

patterns.claim: With one touch on file, there is no measure of how quickly Ravi answers or how long this work usually sits quiet.

hypotheses.proposition: Ravi may be reviewing the doc with his team.

unknowns.question: What kind of work is this — an integration partner, a customer or a vendor? The brief names none.
unknowns.relevance: It decides which playbook the file follows and how long its quiet can run before a check-in is fair.

unknowns.question: What did Ravi need the doc for, and by when?
unknowns.relevance: A date on his side would set when a check-in makes sense.

frames.primary: Work handed over and now in the other side's hands: Ravi asked for the integration doc, you sent it, and the next move is Ravi's.
rivals: An integration going quiet, where a short check-in after a while would be in order.
A partner the brief has not named yet, which may deserve a line of its own.

expected_vs_actual.expected: With no playbook, from the file's own history: after the doc, Ravi reads it and comes back with questions or a next step.
expected_vs_actual.actual: The doc went to Ravi, nothing has come back yet, and nothing in the file is owed by us.

scenarios.do_nothing: Nothing is lost: the ball is with Ravi, and the file waits for his questions.
scenarios.act: A chase this soon adds pressure for no gain; the doc's note already invites his questions.
scenarios.best: Ravi reads the doc and comes back with a next step for the integration.
scenarios.worst: The integration stalls on Ravi's side and nobody notices for weeks.
signals_to_watch: Ravi writing with questions or a next step
A long quiet with no word from Ravi
Anyone else at partnerco.test joining the thread

reasons: The brief names no kind of work for this file, and what Ravi asked for went out.
Nothing is owed by us, and no date is set.
A check-in can be sent at any time, so waiting costs little.

parsed.alternative: If the integration matters and Ravi stays quiet for a couple of weeks, one short check-in from Arjun on whether the doc covered what he needed.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Wait for Ravi's reply; stop waiting, with a single check-in, only if a long quiet sets in and the integration still matters.
parsed.done_when: Ravi confirms the doc covers what he needed, or names the next step.
